content.json:
# 📊 SOC Overview
### Ingestion cost, data source health, and incident summary for the personal Sentinel lab

## 💰 Ingestion & cost
*Daily volume by table against the workspace's 1 GB/day cap. Watch this — past the cap, ingestion gets dropped silently for the rest of the day, and rules/workbooks look "broken" when it's actually just the cap.*

content.query:
Usage
| where IsBillable == true
| summarize IngestedMB = sum(Quantity) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), DataType
| render columnchart
content.title: Daily ingested MB by table

content.query:
Usage
| where TimeGenerated > startofday(now())
| where IsBillable == true
| summarize TodayMB = round(sum(Quantity), 2) by DataType
| extend TodayGB = round(TodayMB / 1024, 4)
| extend PctOfCap = round((TodayGB / 1.0) * 100, 1)
| project DataType, TodayMB, TodayGB, ["% of 1GB cap"] = PctOfCap
| sort by TodayMB desc
content.title: Today's ingestion by table

content.json:
## 💓 Data source health
*Every onboarded source (Syslog VM, this PC via Arc) should heartbeat regularly. A source that's gone quiet stops sending detections silently — this is how you'd notice.*

content.query:
Heartbeat
| summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated), Version = any(Version), OS = any(OSType) by Computer
| extend MinutesSinceLastHeartbeat = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastHeartbeat)
| extend Status = case(MinutesSinceLastHeartbeat < 15, "🟢 Online", MinutesSinceLastHeartbeat < 60, "🟡 Delayed", "🔴 Offline")
| project Computer, Status, MinutesSinceLastHeartbeat, LastHeartbeat, OS, Version
| sort by MinutesSinceLastHeartbeat asc
content.title: Agent heartbeat status

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| summarize Count = count() by Severity, Status
| sort by Count desc
content.title: Incidents by severity and status

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| summarize Count = count() by AlertSeverity, ProviderName
| sort by Count desc
content.title: Alerts by severity and provider

content.json:
## 🪪 Identity activity
*Interactive (SigninLogs) and service-to-service (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs) sign-ins, combined.*

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (SigninLogs | extend Kind = "Interactive"),
    (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | extend Kind = "Non-interactive")
| extend Outcome = iff(ResultType == 0, "Success", "Failure")
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Outcome
| render timechart
content.title: Sign-in success/failure over time

content.query:
AuditLogs
| summarize Count = count() by OperationName, InitiatedByUser = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| sort by Count desc
| take 50
content.title: Top audit operations by actor

content.query:
AzureActivity
| summarize Count = count() by OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue
| sort by Count desc
| take 50
content.title: Top Azure Activity operations

content.query:
Syslog
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Facility
| render timechart
content.title: Syslog events per hour by facility
